meta.description: Nespresso Essenza Mini C30: coffee preparation (Espresso or Lungo).

device_meta.description: Nespresso Essenza Mini C30: coffee preparation (Espresso or Lungo).

components_catalog.name: Espresso button
components_catalog.description: Momentary push button. Its press (press_espresso) is offered to every machine: it turns the machine on (LEDs) and, once ready, brews an Espresso into the cup. The button itself keeps no state.
components_catalog.location: Top surface, next to the lever (left/right order not specified in manual)

dimensions.name: contact
dimensions.description: Momentary contact: returns to released immediately after each press.

components_catalog.name: Lungo button
components_catalog.description: Momentary push button. Its press (press_lungo) is offered to every machine: it turns the machine on (LEDs) and, once ready, brews a Lungo into the cup. The button itself keeps no state.
components_catalog.location: Top surface, next to the lever (left/right order not specified in manual)

dimensions.name: contact
dimensions.description: Momentary contact: returns to released immediately after each press.

components_catalog.name: LEDs
components_catalog.description: Lights integrated in the Espresso and Lungo buttons; observable state of the machine (the internal heating is not modelled, the LEDs that show it are).
components_catalog.location: Integrated in the Espresso and Lungo buttons, top surface

dimensions.name: status
dimensions.description: off; heating = lights blinking (25 s); ready = lights steady.

components_catalog.name: Lever
components_catalog.description: Opens the capsule compartment for capsule insertion; closing locks the system; a lift-and-close cycle after brewing ejects the capsule into the capsule container.
components_catalog.location: Top front of machine, above the coffee outlet

components_catalog.name: Capsule
components_catalog.description: Single-portion Nespresso coffee capsule inserted into the capsule compartment and ejected after brewing.
components_catalog.location: Outside the machine, then in the capsule compartment, then in the capsule container

dimensions.name: position
dimensions.description: outside; in_compartment (inserted with the lever lifted); ejected (dropped into the capsule container by the lever cycle after brewing).

components_catalog.name: Cup
components_catalog.description: Cup placed on the drip grid under the coffee outlet; receives the coffee.
components_catalog.location: On the drip grid under the coffee outlet

dimensions.name: position
dimensions.description: Whether the cup is under the coffee outlet.

dimensions.name: content
dimensions.description: empty; coffee (Espresso 40 ml or Lungo 110 ml, factory volumes).

components_catalog.name: Water tank
components_catalog.description: Holds the water supply (0.6 L); must contain potable water for brewing (water use per cup not modelled).

components_catalog.name: Drip tray
components_catalog.description: Collects drips and spills under the coffee outlet; must be in place before brewing.
components_catalog.location: Front base, below the coffee outlet

dimensions.name: position
dimensions.description: Whether the drip tray is in place.

procedures.name: Coffee preparation
procedures.short_description: Prepares an Espresso (40 ml) or a Lungo (110 ml) from a capsule and ejects the used capsule

steps.description: Press either the Espresso or the Lungo button to turn the machine ON (manual step 1).
steps.simplified_description: Press one of the two coffee buttons on top.

steps.description: Wait while the lights blink (heating up, 25 seconds) until they stay steady: the machine is ready (manual step 1).
steps.simplified_description: Wait until the lights stop blinking.
Pull the lever on top all the way up.
Put the capsule into the hole under the lever.

steps.description: Place a cup under the coffee outlet (manual step 3).
steps.simplified_description: Put the cup under the coffee spout.

steps.description: Press the Espresso (40 ml) or the Lungo (110 ml) button to start; preparation stops automatically (manual step 4).
steps.simplified_description: Press the small-cup or the big-cup button and wait for the coffee.

steps.description: Lift the lever to eject the capsule (manual step 5).
Close the lever: the used capsule drops into the used capsule container (manual step 5).
steps.simplified_description: Push the lever down to throw away the capsule.

procedures.guard: machine_leds.status eq off and machine_lever.position eq closed and machine_capsule.position eq outside and machine_cup.position eq absent and machine_cup.content eq empty and machine_water_tank.content eq potable_water and machine_drip_tray.position eq installed

rules.name: Drip tray in place before brewing
rules.description: Do not use the machine without the drip tray (and grid) to avoid spilling liquid.

rules.name: Cup under the coffee outlet before brewing
rules.description: Do not use the appliance without a cup placed at the suitable level.

rules.name: Lock the system completely before brewing
rules.description: Always lock the system completely (lever closed).

rules.name: Lift the lever completely to insert the capsule
rules.description: Lift the lever completely and insert the capsule.

rules.name: Brew when the machine is ready
rules.description: Steady lights mean ready (pressing while blinking queues the brew; not modelled).

rules.name: Water tank filled with potable water
rules.description: Always fill the water tank with fresh potable water.

rules.name: Never lift the lever during operation
rules.description: Risk of scalding by hot liquids and coffee grounds.

rules.name: Never use a used, damaged or deformed capsule
Capsule is hot after use
rules.description: Risk of scalding; if a capsule is blocked, turn the machine off and unplug it.

rules.name: Do not put fingers under the coffee outlet
Do not put fingers into the capsule compartment
